profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, traded under the ticker XPEV and registered with the U.S. SEC under CIK 0001810997. It is also known as XPENG INC - ADR. Its Spanish website describes the company as having worked since 2014 to turn what the world calls the future into reality. The site presents the XPENG range as fully electric and highlights the G6, G9, and P7+ models, which it says combine artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems, and the SEPA 2.0 800-volt platform. It states that the platform allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range, and that the three models carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years or 160,000 km.

The Spanish site is operated by CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the data controller for inquiries. It lists financing offers for the G6 RWD Standard Range and G9 RWD Standard Range through Open Bank, S.A., with a 36-month term and a maximum of 30,000 km.
